items.title_zh: 《生化危机》之父三上真司：希望 AI 彻底消失
items.title_en: Resident Evil Creator Shinji Mikami: I Hope AI Disappears Completely
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，今年 3 月底，《生化危机》和《恐龙危机》系列导演三上真司（Shinji Mikami）正式宣布，其创立的游戏工作室 Unbound 已与《剑星》开发商 Shift Up 达成合作，将共同发行他的下一款游戏。11 月 20 日，三上真司与 Shift Up 首席执行官金亨泰（Kim Hyung-tae）在 G-CON 2026 活动上参加了一场专题讨论，谈及双方的新合作关系。期间，两位游戏制作人对人工智能截然不同的看法也成为讨论焦点。 据 Inven Global 报道，两人的讨论主要围绕 2027 年及之后游戏开发行业将发生怎样的变化展开。 值得注意的是，金亨泰还正面回应了 Shift Up 此前因使用 AI 制作《剑星：血雨》（Stellar Blade: Blood Rain）全 AI 生成音乐视频而受到的批评。今年 7 月底，该视频发布后引发玩家争议，甚至遭到部分《剑星》粉丝抵制。 金亨泰表示，受到这场争议的影响，工作室确立了新的创作理念，即从头到尾坚持“手工制作”。 IT之家注意到，这并不意味着 Shift Up 将完全放弃 AI。金亨泰解释称，工作室仍计划在部分开发环节使用 AI，例如制作光照效果、生成低多边形 3D 模型等。不过，他认为，如果从项目开发一开始就过度依赖 AI，最终作品就会与普通 AI 使用者也能制作出来的内容没有明显区别。 尽管如此， 金亨泰仍然认为：“如今，不使用 AI 已经很难进行游戏开发。” 三上真司对此持有截然不同的看法。 他透露，Unbound 目前确实在尝试使用 AI，主要用于预览手绘 2D 模型转换成 3D 模型后的效果。但与此同时，他也毫不掩饰自己对 AI 的排斥态度， 甚至表示希望 AI 能够“彻底消失”，不仅从游戏开发领域消失，也希望它“从这个世界上消失”。 对于 AI 将如何影响游戏开发人员未来的就业，三上真司同样持悲观态度。 他认为，未来“五年或十年”将是游戏工作室充满不确定性的时期，并承认未来十年内，游戏开发人员确实存在被 AI 取代、进而失去工作的可能性。 对于三上真司的担忧，金亨泰随后回应称，无论 AI 技术未来发展得多么迅速，Shift Up 和 Unbound 开发的游戏，其本质都将始终坚持手工创作。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: At the end of March this year, Shinji Mikami, director of the Resident Evil and Dino Crisis series, officially announced that his studio Unbound had partnered with Stellar Blade developer Shift Up to co-publish his next game. On November 20, Mikami and Shift Up CEO Kim Hyung-tae took part in a panel discussion at the G-CON 2026 event about their new partnership. During the session, the two producers' sharply differing views on artificial intelligence also became a focus. According to Inven Global, the discussion centered on how the game development industry will change in 2027 and beyond. Notably, Kim Hyung-tae also responded directly to criticism Shift Up faced for using AI to create a fully AI-generated music video for Stellar Blade: Blood Rain. After the video was released in late July this year, it sparked player controversy and even a boycott by some Stellar Blade fans. Kim said that, influenced by the controversy, the studio established a new creative philosophy of sticking to "handmade" from start to finish. IT之家 notes this does not mean Shift Up will abandon AI entirely. Kim explained the studio still plans to use AI in some development stages, such as creating lighting effects and generating low-poly 3D models. However, he believes that over-relying on AI from the very start of a project will make the final work indistinguishable from content ordinary AI users could produce. Nevertheless, Kim still holds that "these days, it's already hard to make games without using AI." Mikami takes a sharply different view. He revealed that Unbound is indeed experimenting with AI, mainly to preview how hand-drawn 2D models look after conversion to 3D. But he also made no secret of his rejection of AI, even saying he hopes AI can "disappear completely" — not only from game development but "from this world." Mikami is equally pessimistic about how AI will affect game developers' future employment. He believes the next "five or ten years" will be a period of great uncertainty for game studios, and acknowledged that within the next decade game developers could indeed be replaced by AI and lose their jobs. Responding to Mikami's concerns, Kim said that no matter how fast AI technology develops, the games developed by Shift Up and Unbound will in essence always stick to handcrafted creation.
items.why_zh: 推测：两位知名制作人在公开场合的分歧，反映出游戏业对生成式 AI 的分裂态度，并涉及开发者就业风险议题；这仅是单场活动的观点表达，不构成行业定论。
items.why_en: Speculative: the public disagreement between two well-known producers reflects the game industry's split stance on generative AI and touches on developer job-risk concerns; it is only remarks at a single event and not an industry conclusion.

items.title_zh: 儿童权益保护组织喊话亚马逊、eBay：别卖 AI 玩具了
items.title_en: Child Rights Coalition Urges Amazon and eBay to Stop Selling AI Toys
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，由 155 家儿童权益保护组织组成的联盟近日向亚马逊和 eBay 首席执行官发出公开信，呼吁两家电商平台停止销售搭载人工智能技术的玩具。联盟指出，这类产品价格低廉、购买门槛低，却缺乏充分的安全测试，可能给儿童带来多方面的风险。 公开信列举了 AI 玩具存在的诸多问题，包括生成色情内容、夸大未经证实的教育效果、侵犯用户隐私，以及向儿童提供寻找和使用家中危险物品的指导等。 IT之家注意到，这封公开信发布之际，美国公共利益研究组织（ U.S . PIRG）刚刚公布了年度玩具安全调查报告。报告发现，与去年相比，部分 AI 玩具在安全性方面取得了重要进展，但仍有一些产品会与儿童进行不恰当的对话，并存在相当大的隐私风险。 例如，在测试过程中，Alilo Smart AI Bunny 智能 AI 兔子玩具不仅告诉测试人员应该在家中什么地方寻找漂白剂，还解释了“恋物癖”一词的含义，讨论具体的性行为场景，解释润滑剂的用途，甚至建议使用“带衬垫的束缚手铐、柔软的软鞭或羽毛挠痒工具”。 随后，亚马逊将这款兔子玩具以及另一款能够进行色情对话的玩具从平台下架。公开信指出，仅在亚马逊美国站，就发现有超过 50 款 AI 玩具在售。 公开信强调：“这些产品应该在进入儿童市场之前就被证明是安全的，而不是等到发现危害后，再一款接一款地下架。” 此次联合行动由儿童权益保护组织 Fairplay、Alliance 4 Children CIC 和 Set@16 牵头发起。 上周五，亚马逊向美国公共利益研究组织表示，公司正在调查相关问题，并已下架部分玩具。 亚马逊在给该组织的声明中表示：“亚马逊始终将儿童和家庭的安全放在重要位置。随着这项技术不断发展，我们正在与行业内的合作伙伴以及政府部门合作，确保为这类产品建立适当的安全防护机制。” 针对 Mashable 的置评请求，eBay 也回应了这封公开信。eBay 发言人在电子邮件中表示：“我们致力于保护平台上的买家和卖家，并持续评估相关政策，与监管机构保持沟通，确保平台始终安全、值得信赖，并能够适应不断变化的安全标准。” 亚马逊也表示，平台要求所有第三方卖家销售的商品遵守适用的法律法规。亚马逊在电子邮件中再次强调：“亚马逊始终将儿童和家庭的安全放在重要位置。随着这项技术不断发展，我们支持行业和政府各方共同努力，为相关产品建立适当的安全防护机制。” 公开信还提到，加利福尼亚州已经通过相关规定，将从 2027 年 1 月起禁止向 16 岁以下儿童销售配备陪伴型聊天机器人的玩具。此外，美国国会也有一项法案提议禁止在玩具中使用 AI 聊天机器人。 不过，联名组织认为，亚马逊和 eBay 没必要等到相关禁令正式生效才采取行动。 公开信最后直接向两家电商平台喊话：“你们不必等到那一天。电商平台有责任确保所售商品的安全，而且你们本来就有下架不安全商品的机制。”
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: A coalition of 155 child rights organizations recently sent an open letter to the CEOs of Amazon and eBay, calling on the two e-commerce platforms to stop selling toys equipped with artificial intelligence technology. The coalition said such products are cheap and easy to buy, yet lack adequate safety testing and may pose multiple risks to children. The letter listed numerous problems with AI toys, including generating pornographic content, exaggerating unverified educational benefits, violating user privacy, and giving children guidance on finding and using dangerous household items. IT之家 notes the letter comes just as the U.S. PIRG released its annual toy safety survey report. The report found that compared with last year some AI toys have made important progress in safety, but some products still hold inappropriate conversations with children and carry considerable privacy risks. For example, during testing, the Alilo Smart AI Bunny toy not only told testers where in the home to look for bleach, but also explained the meaning of the word "fetish," discussed specific sexual scenarios, explained the purpose of lubricant, and even suggested using "padded bondage cuffs, soft floggers or feather ticklers." Amazon subsequently removed this bunny toy and another toy capable of erotic conversation from its platform. The letter noted that more than 50 AI toys were found on sale on Amazon's U.S. site alone. The letter stressed: "These products should be proven safe before they enter the children's market, not taken down one by one after harm is discovered." The joint action was led by child rights organizations Fairplay, Alliance 4 Children CIC and Set@16. Last Friday, Amazon told U.S. PIRG that it is investigating the issues and has removed some toys. In a statement to the organization, Amazon said: "Amazon always puts the safety of children and families first. As this technology continues to evolve, we are working with industry partners and government agencies to ensure appropriate safeguards are established for these products." Responding to Mashable's request for comment, eBay also responded to the open letter. An eBay spokesperson said in an email: "We are committed to protecting buyers and sellers on our platform and continuously evaluate our policies and stay in touch with regulators to ensure the platform remains safe, trustworthy and able to adapt to evolving safety standards." Amazon also said the platform requires all third-party sellers' products to comply with applicable laws and regulations, reiterating in the email: "Amazon always puts the safety of children and families first. As this technology continues to evolve, we support joint efforts by industry and government to establish appropriate safeguards for relevant products." The letter also mentioned that California has passed rules banning the sale of toys equipped with companion chatbots to children under 16 starting January 2027. In addition, a bill in the U.S. Congress proposes banning AI chatbots in toys. However, the coalition argues Amazon and eBay need not wait for such bans to take effect. The letter concluded by addressing the two platforms directly: "You don't have to wait for that day. E-commerce platforms have a responsibility to ensure the safety of the goods they sell, and you already have mechanisms to remove unsafe products."
items.why_zh: 推测：这是儿童安全组织较具规模的联合施压，可能推动电商自律或加速监管落地；但两家平台目前仅表示调查、下架部分产品并评估政策，尚无统一规则。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is a relatively large-scale joint push by child-safety groups that could prompt platform self-regulation or speed up regulation; however, both platforms have only said they are investigating, removing some products and evaluating policies, with no unified rules yet.

items.title_en: Dongchedi Responds to "Major Testing Content Overhaul" Claims: Reports Inaccurate, Some Content AI-Written
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，今日，有博主爆料称，懂车帝内部对公开测试发布了四项要求，包括不再开放对比类内容、想要发布公开测试类内容的账号必须有资质等。 据界面新闻报道，懂车帝内容运营人员表示，此轮变化系平台严格按照《网络测评活动规范》要求，对汽车创作者在平台发布部分场景内容的规则更新。 网传“内容大调整”“行业受影响”等信息多处失实，部分内容为 AI 撰写，未跟平台核实求证 。 参考IT之家此前报道，今年 9 月，工业和信息化部举行新闻发布会，介绍了我国智能网联新能源汽车产业发展有关情况。 对于汽车行业出现的非理性竞争行为，工业和信息化部装备工业一司司长郭守刚表示，汽车行业出现非理性竞争现象，不仅造成大量资源浪费，而且扭曲资源配置效率、扰乱市场竞争秩序、抑制创新活力，成为阻碍汽车产业高质量发展的一大顽疾。 工业和信息化部会同有关部门制定实施规范工作方案，建立行业企业交流会商机制，指导行业机构发布规范倡议，协同开展供应商账期优化、车辆产品一致性监督检查、网络乱象整治、重点企业督导调研、优化产业布局引导等工作，远近结合、综合施策系统推进治理。综合来看，经过各方面共同努力，治理工作取得积极成效，企业经营行为更趋理性，打“口水战”、互相揭短等网络乱象得到初步治理，供应商账期情况有效改善，产业竞争秩序正在回归理性。 郭守刚还提到，会持续规范产业竞争秩序。深入整治行业网络乱象， 引导规范新车发布和产品测评活动 。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: Today a blogger claimed that Dongchedi internally issued four requirements for public testing, including no longer offering comparison-type content and requiring accounts that want to publish public testing content to hold qualifications. According to Jiemian News, Dongchedi content operations staff said this round of changes is a rules update, in strict accordance with the "Network Evaluation Activity Specifications," for automotive creators publishing certain scenario content on the platform. Online claims of a "major content overhaul" and "the industry being affected" are inaccurate in many places, and some content was written by AI without verification with the platform. As IT之家 previously reported, in September this year the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology held a press conference on the development of China's intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry. Regarding irrational competition in the auto industry, Guo Shougang, director of the MIIT Equipment Industry Division I, said such competition not only wastes large amounts of resources but also distorts resource allocation efficiency, disrupts market competition order and suppresses innovation vitality, becoming a major chronic problem hindering high-quality development of the auto industry. MIIT, together with relevant departments, formulated and implemented a standardization work plan, established an industry-enterprise consultation mechanism, guided industry organizations to issue standardization initiatives, and coordinated work on optimizing supplier payment terms, supervising vehicle product consistency, rectifying online chaos, conducting supervision and surveys of key enterprises, and optimizing industrial layout guidance, advancing governance systematically with both near- and long-term measures. Overall, through joint efforts, governance has achieved positive results: corporate behavior has become more rational, online chaos such as "war of words" and mutual mudslinging has been initially curbed, supplier payment terms have effectively improved, and industrial competition order is returning to rationality. Guo also said the ministry will continue to regulate industrial competition order, deeply rectify online chaos in the industry, and guide and standardize new vehicle launches and product evaluation activities.
items.why_zh: 推测：若平台确实收紧测评规则，可能影响汽车内容生态与消费者获取对比信息的方式；但平台称网传说法多处失实，具体规则细节尚未公开。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the platform has indeed tightened evaluation rules, it could affect the automotive content ecosystem and how consumers obtain comparison information; however, the platform says the circulated claims are inaccurate in many places and the specific rules have not been made public.

items.title_zh: 马斯克：星巴克咖啡师也能建 AI 数据中心，SpaceX 培训几天就能上岗
items.title_en: Musk: Even Starbucks Baristas Can Build AI Data Centers After a Few Days of SpaceX Training
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）表示，公司最优秀的数据中心建设人员，可能曾经是咖啡师，也可能只是零售商店里的货架理货员。 本周早些时候，马斯克通过远程连线方式参加了在美国奥斯汀举行的 TomorrowX 峰会。他在会上表示：“我们有些最优秀的员工此前从未参与过数据中心建设。” 马斯克透露，SpaceX 已经组建了一支内部团队，名为“ArmyX”。 这支团队将建设数据中心所需的各项工作拆解成更小的任务，并将其设计成“只需几天就能培训掌握”的工作内容 。 马斯克表示：“我们不需要那些一辈子都在铺设网络线缆的人。我们会把工作拆解成不同任务，这样就能培训新人，即便他们以前可能只是星巴克的咖啡师，或者在塔吉特（Target）超市负责货架理货。” IT之家注意到，这位亿万富翁还特别称赞了零售业和快餐业从业者能够为数据中心建设带来的技能与职业素养。他尤其提到了一名曾在美国汉堡连锁品牌 In-N-Out 工作的厨师。 马斯克说：“如果你能从 In-N-Out 找到一些顶尖员工，他们整天都能把汉堡做得非常出色、始终保持品质，那么他们铺设网络线缆也一定会干得非常出色。” 据马斯克介绍，这支团队正在推动 SpaceX 扩建位于美国孟菲斯的 Colossus 1 和 Colossus 2 两座大型数据中心。在 SpaceX 最近一次财报电话会议上，马斯克表示，到 2027 年底，如果公司的算力增量低于 13 吉瓦，他会感到意外。 与整个 AI 行业一样，SpaceX 也在数据中心建设上投入了大量资源。根据公司最新财报，SpaceX 在人工智能领域的支出已经达到历史最高水平，而且未来可能还会翻一番。 SpaceX 曾向员工提供 20% 的薪资涨幅，条件是员工自愿前往孟菲斯，或密西西比州南海文（Southaven）工作六周。南海文同样建有一座大型数据中心。 马斯克表示，孟菲斯的数据中心建设工作如今已经逐渐进入高效运转状态。他说：“现在我去孟菲斯的次数相当频繁，那里正在变成一台运转良好的机器，各项工作都在有条不紊地推进。我们实行 7×24 小时不间断作业。因此，我凌晨一两点在工地巡视时，看到的整体工作效率与第二天上午 10 点差不多，而且一周七天都是如此。”
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said the company's best data center construction workers may have previously been baristas, or simply shelf stockers in retail stores. Earlier this week, Musk joined the TomorrowX summit in Austin, Texas, via remote link. He said at the event: "Some of our best employees had never worked on data center construction before." Musk revealed SpaceX has formed an internal team called "ArmyX." The team breaks the various tasks needed to build a data center into smaller tasks designed to be "learnable in just a few days of training." Musk said: "We don't need people who've spent their whole lives laying network cables. We break the work into different tasks so we can train newcomers, even if they were previously a barista at Starbucks or stocking shelves at Target." IT之家 notes the billionaire also particularly praised the skills and work ethic retail and fast-food workers can bring to data center construction, especially mentioning a cook who had worked at U.S. burger chain In-N-Out. Musk said: "If you can find top employees at In-N-Out who make burgers excellently all day with consistent quality, they'll surely do excellent work laying network cables too." According to Musk, the team is driving SpaceX's expansion of two large data centers, Colossus 1 and Colossus 2, in Memphis, USA. On SpaceX's most recent earnings call, Musk said he would be surprised if the company's compute increment by the end of 2027 was below 13 gigawatts. Like the entire AI industry, SpaceX is investing heavily in data center construction. According to the company's latest financial report, SpaceX's spending in the AI field has reached a historic high and may double in the future. SpaceX has offered employees a 20% pay raise on condition they volunteer to work for six weeks in Memphis or in Southaven, Mississippi, where another large data center is located. Musk said data center construction in Memphis is now gradually reaching an efficient operating state. He said: "I now go to Memphis quite often; it's turning into a well-oiled machine, with everything proceeding in an orderly way. We operate 7×24. So when I tour the site at 1 or 2 a.m., overall work efficiency looks about the same as at 10 a.m. the next day, seven days a week."
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映出 AI 数据中心建设正把高技术工种拆解为可快速培训的流程化作业，可能影响相关劳动力结构与招聘标准；仅为马斯克在会议上的说法，未提供具体数据支撑。
items.why_en: Speculative: this suggests AI data center construction is breaking high-skill work into quickly trainable, process-based tasks, which could affect labor structure and hiring standards; it is only Musk's remarks at a conference, without specific supporting data.

items.title_zh: 动视新专利：AI 学习玩家聊天内容，生成个性化 NPC 台词
items.title_en: Activision Patent: AI Learns From Player Voice Chat to Generate Personalized NPC Lines
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，《使命召唤》（Call of Duty）发行商动视（Activision）申请了一项新专利，计划利用玩家在游戏中的真实语音聊天训练 NPC（非玩家角色）。这套由 AI 驱动的系统能够监听玩家在关键游戏事件前后的语音交流，学习他们对不同情况的反应，并在之后让游戏角色模仿这些反应。 据 Patentlyze 发现，这项专利于今年 7 月提交，并于 11 月公开。根据专利文件及其附带示意图，该系统采用一种能够自主学习的神经网络，可以识别击杀、远距离击杀、角色死亡等重要游戏事件，并记录事件发生前后玩家的语音及反应。 这些反应可能非常简单，例如短暂的欢呼、叹气或大喊，也可能比较复杂，例如玩家之间的垃圾话和言语挑衅。 据IT之家了解，系统会对采集到的玩家语音进行分析，并将其与同时发生的游戏事件关联起来，从而理解玩家为何会作出特定反应。换句话说，AI 会在游戏过程中不断学习，逐渐掌握哪些游戏事件容易引发玩家的哪些反应。 完成学习后，AI 便能在类似游戏场景再次出现时迅速识别相关事件，并生成相应的语音回应。 需要注意的是，系统并不会直接照搬玩家自己的语音聊天内容。它会为每名接受分析的玩家建立独立档案，以便生成更符合其交流习惯的回应。例如，NPC 可以使用与玩家相同的语言进行交流。为此，系统会借助大语言模型（LLM）识别玩家使用的语言。 专利还提到了一套内容过滤机制，用于防止 NPC 学习带有冒犯性的语言，例如针对特定群体的侮辱性称呼。 值得注意的是，这套系统的语音采集范围可能不局限于游戏内聊天，还可能延伸至 Discord 等主流语音通信应用。 动视希望借此让 NPC 能够像真人一样自然交流，而不是反复播放预先录制好的固定台词。这项技术主要面向多人游戏，包括合作模式。 例如，在 PvE（玩家对抗环境）游戏中，AI 队友经常会重复使用“掩护我”等通用语音指令；在大逃杀和 PvP（玩家对抗玩家）模式中，数十甚至数百名玩家之间也存在大量类似的固定语音交流。动视希望通过 AI 学习玩家的真实对话，让这些互动变得更加自然。 专利还提到，即使玩家进入对局时没有佩戴麦克风，系统也可以利用已经学习到的语音内容，替换原本那些千篇一律的提示语。此外，玩家似乎还可以选择让自己的游戏角色始终使用 AI 生成的语音进行交流。 随着游戏行业持续讨论生成式 AI 在游戏开发中的应用，动视这项专利选择了一条颇为特别的技术路线：直接从真人玩家身上学习，让 AI 掌握人类真实的交流方式。某种程度上，这也回到了大语言模型和 AI 系统获取知识的最初途径 —— 从人类身上学习。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: Call of Duty publisher Activision has applied for a new patent that plans to use players' real in-game voice chat to train NPCs (non-player characters). The AI-driven system can listen to players' voice communications before and after key game events, learn their reactions to different situations, and later have game characters imitate those reactions. According to Patentlyze, the patent was filed in July this year and published in November. According to the patent document and accompanying diagrams, the system uses a self-learning neural network that can identify important game events such as kills, long-range kills and character deaths, and record players' speech and reactions before and after those events. These reactions may be very simple, such as brief cheers, sighs or shouts, or more complex, such as trash talk and verbal taunts between players. IT之家 understands the system analyzes the captured player speech and associates it with simultaneously occurring game events to understand why players react in certain ways. In other words, the AI keeps learning during gameplay, gradually grasping which game events tend to trigger which player reactions. After learning, the AI can quickly identify relevant events when similar game scenarios occur again and generate corresponding voice responses. Note that the system does not directly copy players' own voice chat content. It builds a separate profile for each analyzed player to generate responses more in line with their communication habits. For example, an NPC can communicate in the same language as the player; to do so, the system uses a large language model (LLM) to identify the player's language. The patent also mentions a content filtering mechanism to prevent NPCs from learning offensive language, such as slurs targeting specific groups. Notably, the system's voice capture may extend beyond in-game chat to mainstream voice communication apps such as Discord. Activision hopes this will let NPCs communicate naturally like real people rather than repeatedly playing pre-recorded fixed lines. The technology is mainly aimed at multiplayer games, including co-op modes. For example, in PvE (player vs. environment) games, AI teammates often repeatedly use generic voice commands such as "cover me"; in battle royale and PvP (player vs. player) modes, there is also a lot of similar fixed voice communication among dozens or even hundreds of players. Activision hopes to make these interactions more natural by having AI learn players' real conversations. The patent also mentions that even if a player enters a match without a microphone, the system can use already-learned voice content to replace the originally uniform prompts. In addition, players may be able to choose to have their game characters always communicate using AI-generated voice. As the game industry continues to discuss the use of generative AI in game development, Activision's patent takes a rather distinctive technical route: learning directly from real players so AI can master how humans really communicate. In a sense, this returns to the original way LLMs and AI systems acquire knowledge — learning from humans.

items.source_title: 动视新专利：AI 学习玩家聊天内容，生成个性化 NPC 台词
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，《使命召唤》（Call of Duty）发行商动视（Activision）申请了一项新专利，计划利用玩家在游戏中的真实语音聊天训练 NPC（非玩家角色）。这套由 AI 驱动的系统能够监听玩家在关键游戏事件前后的语音交流，学习他们对不同情况的反应，并在之后让游戏角色模仿这些反应。 据 Patentlyze 发现，这项专利于今年 7 月提交，并于 11 月公开。根据专利文件及其附带示意图，该系统采用一种能够自主学习的神经网络，可以识别击杀、远距离击杀、角色死亡等重要游戏事件，并记录事件发生前后玩家的语音及反应。 这些反应可能非常简单，例如短暂的欢呼、叹气或大喊，也可能比较复杂，例如玩家之间的垃圾话和言语挑衅。 据IT之家了解，系统会对采集到的玩家语音进行分析，并将其与同时发生的游戏事件关联起来，从而理解玩家为何会作出特定反应。换句话说，AI 会在游戏过程中不断学习，逐渐掌握哪些游戏事件容易引发玩家的哪些反应。 完成学习后，AI 便能在类似游戏场景再次出现时迅速识别相关事件，并生成相应的语音回应。 需要注意的是，系统并不会直接照搬玩家自己的语音聊天内容。它会为每名接受分析的玩家建立独立档案，以便生成更符合其交流习惯的回应。例如，NPC 可以使用与玩家相同的语言进行交流。为此，系统会借助大语言模型（LLM）识别玩家使用的语言。 专利还提到了一套内容过滤机制，用于防止 NPC 学习带有冒犯性的语言，例如针对特定群体的侮辱性称呼。 值得注意的是，这套系统的语音采集范围可能不局限于游戏内聊天，还可能延伸至 Discord 等主流语音通信应用。 动视希望借此让 NPC 能够像真人一样自然交流，而不是反复播放预先录制好的固定台词。这项技术主要面向多人游戏，包括合作模式。 例如，在 PvE（玩家对抗环境）游戏中，AI 队友经常会重复使用“掩护我”等通用语音指令；在大逃杀和 PvP（玩家对抗玩家）模式中，数十甚至数百名玩家之间也存在大量类似的固定语音交流。动视希望通过 AI 学习玩家的真实对话，让这些互动变得更加自然。 专利还提到，即使玩家进入对局时没有佩戴麦克风，系统也可以利用已经学习到的语音内容，替换原本那些千篇一律的提示语。此外，玩家似乎还可以选择让自己的游戏角色始终使用 AI 生成的语音进行交流。 随着游戏行业持续讨论生成式 AI 在游戏开发中的应用，动视这项专利选择了一条颇为特别的技术路线：直接从真人玩家身上学习，让 AI 掌握人类真实的交流方式。某种程度上，这也回到了大语言模型和 AI 系统获取知识的最初途径 —— 从人类身上学习。

items.title_zh: Epic 旗下 AI 游戏开发竞赛现讽刺一幕：纯人工制作游戏《LSD: FIH》获玩家投票榜首
items.title_en: Ironic Twist in Epic's AI Game Jam: Fully Hand-Made "LSD: FIH" Tops Player Vote
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，据外媒 Tweaktown 报道，Epic Games 举办的 AI MegaJam 游戏开发竞赛近日出现一款颇具反差的作品。由开发者 PolyCube 制作的《LSD：FIH》明确表示开发过程中完全没有使用人工智能（AI），却在目前的玩家公开投票中位居榜首。 公开信息显示，本届 AI MegaJam 竞赛奖金池总额为 5 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.4 万元人民币） 。主办方鼓励开发者使用多种 AI 工具和 Vibe Coding（氛围编程）方式打造作品。不过根据赛事介绍， 使用 AI 并非参赛或获奖的强制要求 。 参考玩家公开投票，现阶段人气最高的作品为《LSD: FIH》，这是一款完全由人工开发的作品，游戏玩法相当简单，玩家将扮演一条手持狙击步枪的鱼，需要尽可能快速地击落屏幕中的球体，以维持连击计数。 当其他参赛者尝试借助 AI 编程工具争取更好成绩时，PolyCube 则选择完全自行编写代码，并在游戏介绍中明确标注开发过程中没有使用任何 AI。 这一做法与赛事鼓励 AI 辅助开发的主题形成鲜明反差 。 这款作品的意外走红也引发了社区讨论。有观点认为，《LSD: FIH》之所以能够获得大量玩家支持，可能与部分玩家对 Epic Games 首席执行官 Tim Sweeney 近期发表的支持 AI 言论不满有关。 此前，Tim Sweeney 曾公开批评 Steam 的 AI 内容披露政策，称相关规定“令人憎恶”（abhorrent），并认为这类标签可能助长针对游戏开发者的抵制行动，进而损害开发者的生计。在这一背景下，一款完全由人工编写代码、且明确拒绝使用 AI 的作品，反而在 AI 主题竞赛中获得大量支持，也让这场 AI MegaJam 竞赛出现了颇具讽刺意味的一幕。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 23 news: According to foreign media Tweaktown, Epic Games' AI MegaJam game development competition recently featured a notably contrasting entry. "LSD: FIH," made by developer PolyCube, explicitly states that no artificial intelligence (AI) was used in development, yet currently ranks first in public player voting. Public information shows this year's AI MegaJam has a total prize pool of $50,000 (IT之家 note: about 334,000 yuan at current exchange rates). Organizers encourage developers to use various AI tools and "Vibe Coding" to create works. However, according to the event description, using AI is not mandatory for entry or for winning. Looking at public player voting, the most popular work at this stage is "LSD: FIH," a completely manually developed title with quite simple gameplay: players play as a fish holding a sniper rifle and must shoot down spheres on screen as quickly as possible to maintain a combo count. While other participants tried AI coding tools to get better results, PolyCube chose to write all the code itself and explicitly noted in the game description that no AI was used in development. This forms a sharp contrast with the event's theme of encouraging AI-assisted development. The work's unexpected popularity has also sparked community discussion. Some argue that the large player support for "LSD: FIH" may be related to dissatisfaction with recent pro-AI remarks by Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney. Sweeney previously publicly criticized Steam's AI content disclosure policy, calling the rules "abhorrent" and arguing such labels could fuel boycotts against game developers and harm developers' livelihoods. Against this backdrop, a work coded entirely by hand and explicitly rejecting AI gaining broad support in an AI-themed competition makes for an ironic scene at AI MegaJam.
items.why_zh: 推测：投票结果可能被部分玩家当作对 AI 立场的表态，而非纯粹的作品质量评价；这一关联由外媒与社区讨论提出，未获证实。
items.why_en: Speculative: the vote may be read by some players as a statement about AI stances rather than a pure quality judgment; this link is suggested by foreign media and community discussion and is unconfirmed.

items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 23 that Lenovo has listed the Lecoo exoskeleton robot Walker ONE wearable walking-assistance device on JD.com. It will go on sale on Nov 28 at a list price of 7,999 yuan, with a first-release price of 6,999 yuan. The product weighs 1.8kg, offers IP54 protection, uses three-point support to distribute local pressure and a three-point one-buckle tightening system, and can be put on or taken off in 15 seconds. It has transparent and smart motion modes, with dual-hip peak torque of up to 38N·m and peak power of 900W; it claims walking-assistance efficiency of ≥45% and supports one-button adjustment of the assistance ratio. It is equipped with an AI gait sensing system that can recognize six posture types—uphill/downhill, running, stairs, hiking, cycling and gravel terrain (gradually enabled)—and fourfold protection: motor overload protection, battery overheating protection, joint pull protection and abnormality warning protection. It comes standard with two 3000mAh removable batteries, with a theoretical battery life of about 3 hours at level-3 assistance. IT Home attached product specifications.

items.title_en: Docker unveils new logo, aiming for secure containerized environments for agents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，知名容器化工具 Docker 官方当地时间本月 19 日宣布更新徽标。 新版的 Moby 鲸鱼更为抽象简洁 ， 且以黑色为身体基调 。 Docker 官方在其配套博客中表示，新徽标下的 Docker 专为信任而生， 致力于打造面向智能体时代的容器化环境 ，让安全、隔离、治理的容器成为智能体可信执行环境的一部分。 当然，Docker 并未抛弃传统：其依然致力于开放和行业合作，始终将开发者放在首位，依然追求极致简洁。 参考 https://www.docker.com/blog/meet-the-new-docker-built-to-run-on-trust/
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 23 that Docker, the well-known containerization tool, announced a logo update on the 19th local time. The new Moby whale is more abstract and simple, with black as the base color of its body. In a companion blog post, Docker said the Docker under the new logo is 'built for trust,' aiming to create a containerized environment for the agent era and make secure, isolated and governed containers part of a trusted execution environment for agents. Docker has not abandoned tradition: it remains committed to openness and industry collaboration, puts developers first and continues to pursue extreme simplicity. Reference: https://www.docker.com/blog/meet-the-new-docker-built-to-run-on-trust/
items.why_zh: 推测：Docker 将智能体作为容器化环境的重要场景，反映 AI 智能体基础设施的安全与治理需求受到关注。

items.title_en: Phone is just the start: Huawei OSTA's Liu He confirms full-scenario products, with small tablet reportedly planned
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于 11 月 20 日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。华为星芒品牌总经理刘赫也已开通微博，持续解答网友疑惑。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 IT之家注意到，面对网友提问品牌未来规划是否会扩展至电脑、手环、智能家居，刘赫表示：“安排，我们是全场景的， 手机只是开始 。” 最新爆料显示， 华为子品牌星芒除了手机，还会有平板、笔记本、穿戴产品等 ，目前确认「星芒小平板」已安排。星芒品牌主打先锋科技，前期产品大部分是华为换皮，后期会有独立开发的产品，定位更加激进，目前规划都是中高端产品线。 相关阅读： 《 消息称华为星芒小平板已安排，还有笔记本、穿戴产品等 》 延伸阅读 OSTA 星芒品牌英文名取自 Original（原创）、Smart（智能）、Technology（科技）、Accessible（触手可及）的首字母，品牌口号为“Come As You Are，自有光芒”，主张“先锋不止设计，用创新探索更多方向，以技术连接无限可能”，面向年轻群体、聚焦中高端市场。 作为首款产品，OSTA O1 Pro 采用阔直板设计，搭载麒麟 9030S 旗舰芯片，配备 2 亿像素红枫智拍、7000mAh 大电池和昆仑玻璃，首发搭载鸿蒙 7 AI 先锋版操作系统。价格方面，12GB+256GB 版本售价 5699 元，16GB+1TB 顶配版本售价 8999 元，先锋者尝鲜价 5499 元起，叠加国补后 4999 元起，于 11 月 20 日 18:08 正式开售。 在华为终端版图上，OSTA 星芒并非又一条产品系列，而是与“HUAWEI”品牌并列的双品牌架构的另一极，两者差异化定位、互补发展。星芒与华为主品牌共享麒麟芯片、鸿蒙操作系统、昆仑玻璃、红枫影像等技术底座与品质标准，该品牌隶属于华为终端 BG，与华为主品牌共用制造工厂。 市场普遍将这一定位与荣耀作比较。荣耀诞生于 2013 年，主打年轻用户和中低端价位，2020 年华为因外部制裁出售荣耀，以保障渠道商和供应商继续经营；有分析认为，星芒意在填补荣耀从华为剥离后留下的中高端与年轻人群市场空白。 此外，京东已与华为 OSTA 星芒签署战略合作协议，目标在未来三年内实现全品类销售额 700 亿元。星芒相关负责人透露，该品牌已在内部酝酿约三年，未来一两年不会提出过高的销量及经营目标要求，现阶段任务是建立品牌认知、培育目标用户并验证新的 AI 技术与产品体验。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 23 that Huawei OSTA O1 Pro, the first HarmonyOS phone 'born for AI,' was officially launched on the afternoon of Nov 20, starting at 4,999 yuan after national subsidies. Liu He, general manager of the Huawei OSTA brand, has opened a Weibo account to answer users' questions. Asked whether the brand's future plans would expand to computers, wristbands and smart home devices, Liu said: 'Arranged; we are full-scenario, and the phone is just the start.' Recent leaks indicate that Huawei sub-brand OSTA will have not only phones but also tablets, laptops and wearable products; the 'OSTA small tablet' is said to be confirmed as arranged. The OSTA brand focuses on pioneering technology; most early products are Huawei rebadges, with independently developed products later, and its positioning is more aggressive, with current plans all in mid-to-high-end product lines. The English name OSTA comes from the initials of Original, Smart, Technology and Accessible, and the slogan is 'Come As You Are.' As the first product, OSTA O1 Pro uses a wide bar design, is equipped with the Kirin 9030S flagship chip, a 200-megapixel Red Maple smart camera, a 7000mAh large battery and Kunlun Glass, and debuts HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition. Prices are 5,699 yuan for 12GB+256GB and 8,999 yuan for the top 16GB+1TB version; pioneer early-adopter prices start at 5,499 yuan, or 4,999 yuan after national subsidies, with official sales starting at 18:08 on Nov 20. In Huawei's terminal lineup, OSTA is not another product series but the other pole of a dual-brand architecture alongside the 'HUAWEI' brand, with differentiated positioning and complementary development. OSTA shares technical foundations and quality standards with the main Huawei brand, including Kirin chips, HarmonyOS, Kunlun Glass and Red Maple imaging; it belongs to Huawei Terminal BG and shares manufacturing plants with the main brand. The market widely compares this positioning with Honor. Honor was founded in 2013, targeting young users and mid-to-low-end prices; in 2020 Huawei sold Honor due to external sanctions to ensure distributors and suppliers could continue operating. Some analysts believe OSTA aims to fill the mid-to-high-end and young-audience market gap left after Honor was spun off from Huawei. In addition, JD.com has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Huawei OSTA, targeting 70 billion yuan in all-category sales over the next three years. A relevant OSTA executive said the brand has been in internal preparation for about three years and will not set excessively high sales or operating targets in the next one or two years; its current task is to build brand awareness, cultivate target users and validate new AI technologies and product experiences.
items.why_zh: 推测：若星芒按报道扩展至平板、笔记本和穿戴等全场景，可能加剧华为在年轻中高端市场的品牌与产品竞争，但相关规划多来自报道和爆料。
items.why_en: Speculative: if OSTA expands into tablets, laptops and wearables as reported, it may intensify Huawei's brand and product competition in the young mid-to-high-end market, but many of the plans come from reports and leaks.

items.title_zh: 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 新机确认支持 eSIM 能力：最多四号，允许同时启用双卡
items.title_en: Huawei OSTA O1 Pro Confirmed to Support eSIM: Up to Four Numbers, Dual SIM Usable Simultaneously
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于 11 月 20 日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 IT之家注意到，华为官网最新显示， 星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 支持 eSIM 能力 。 该功能需开通运营商相关业务使用，同一个手机可以存储最多 2 个 eSIM 号码，目前仅部分运营商提供 eSIM 业务。 当前同一个 eSIM 手机上最多允许支持四个号码 （2 张实体卡号码 + 2 个 eSIM 号码）， 可以同时使用两个号码 （可支持“两张实体卡”、“一张实体卡 + 任一 eSIM 号码”和“两个 eSIM 号码”三种方案）。 延伸阅读 OSTA 星芒是华为于 2026 年 11 月 20 日推出的全新子品牌，被官方称为华为双品牌布局的重要一环，与华为主品牌共享技术底座、统一品质标准，定位为面向先锋探索者的鸿蒙 AI 全场景科技品牌，其首款产品即为 OSTA O1 Pro。目前已有 500 余家鸿蒙生态伙伴参与 OSTA 星芒项目。 硬件配置方面，OSTA O1 Pro 搭载麒麟 9030S 芯片与 HarmonyOS 7 AI 先锋版操作系统，配备 6.39 英寸 16:9.5 比例的阔感 OLED 屏幕（2232 × 1320 分辨率、120Hz 刷新率、6500nits 局部峰值亮度），内置 7000mAh 大电池，支持 66W 有线快充与 50W 无线快充。 该机提供星空黑、星云白、星芒紫三款配色，存储版本与官方首发价分别为：12GB+256GB 版 5699 元、12GB+512GB 版 6699 元、16GB+512GB 版 7499 元、16GB+1TB 版 8999 元。 外观方面，OSTA O1 Pro 采用 16:9.5 比例的阔直板形态，正面四边黑边宽度均为 1.05mm，屏占比达到 96.1%，机身厚度 6.68mm，重量控制在约 203g，搭配轻质合金中框。 eSIM 即嵌入式 SIM 卡，是通过远程配置将号码写入手机等终端的通信方案，无需插入实体卡片，具备节省机身空间、可多号存储、便于切换等优势，目前已逐步成为手机、智能穿戴、平板等设备的主流配置方式。 在国内，三大运营商均已推出面向手机的 eSIM 业务：中国联通覆盖苹果、华为、OPPO、荣耀、三星、vivo、联想等品牌的国行 eSIM 机型；中国移动单台手机最多可存储 2 个移动 eSIM 号码；中国电信则主要支持 iPhone、华为 Mate 系列等旗舰机型。手机 eSIM 套餐与实体卡套餐通用，暂无额外溢价。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 23 that Huawei's first HarmonyOS phone built for AI, the Star Series (OSTA) O1 Pro, was officially launched on the afternoon of Nov 20, starting at 4,999 yuan after national subsidies. IT之家 noted that Huawei's official website now shows the OSTA O1 Pro supports eSIM; the feature requires activating the relevant carrier service, one phone can store up to 2 eSIM numbers, and currently only some carriers offer eSIM services. A single eSIM phone can currently hold up to four numbers (2 physical SIM numbers + 2 eSIM numbers) and can use two numbers simultaneously (three options: two physical SIMs, one physical SIM plus either eSIM number, or two eSIM numbers). An extended reading in the article says OSTA is a new Huawei sub-brand launched on Nov 20, 2026, described officially as an important part of Huawei's dual-brand layout, sharing the same technology base and unified quality standards with the main Huawei brand and positioned as a HarmonyOS AI all-scenario technology brand for pioneering explorers, with the OSTA O1 Pro as its first product; more than 500 HarmonyOS ecosystem partners have joined the OSTA project. On hardware, the OSTA O1 Pro carries the Kirin 9030S chip and HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition, a 6.39-inch 16:9.5 OLED screen (2232 × 1320, 120Hz, 6500nits local peak brightness), a 7000mAh battery, 66W wired and 50W wireless charging. Colors are Starry Black, Nebula White and Star Purple, with official launch prices of 5,699 yuan (12GB+256GB), 6,699 yuan (12GB+512GB), 7,499 yuan (16GB+512GB) and 8,999 yuan (16GB+1TB). It uses a 16:9.5 flat form factor with 1.05mm bezels on all four sides, 96.1% screen-to-body ratio, 6.68mm thickness, about 203g weight and a lightweight alloy frame. The article explains that eSIM is an embedded SIM that writes numbers to a device remotely without a physical card, saving space and allowing multiple stored numbers and easier switching. In China, all three major carriers offer phone eSIM services: China Unicom covers China-market eSIM models from Apple, Huawei, OPPO, Honor, Samsung, vivo and Lenovo; China Mobile allows up to 2 stored China Mobile eSIM numbers per phone; China Telecom mainly supports flagship models such as iPhone and Huawei Mate series. Phone eSIM plans are the same as physical SIM plans with no extra premium for now.
items.why_zh: 推测：该机型公布 eSIM 多号与双卡并发方案，显示国内手机 eSIM 商用持续推进，可能影响运营商适配与终端卖点竞争。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于 11 月 20 日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 IT之家注意到，华为官网最新显示， 星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 支持 eSIM 能力 。 该功能需开通运营商相关业务使用，同一个手机可以存储最多 2 个 eSIM 号码，目前仅部分运营商提供 eSIM 业务。 当前同一个 eSIM 手机上最多允许支持四个号码 （2 张实体卡号码 + 2 个 eSIM 号码）， 可以同时使用两个号码 （可支持“两张实体卡”、“一张实体卡 + 任一 eSIM 号码”和“两个 eSIM 号码”三种方案）。 延伸阅读 OSTA 星芒是华为于 2026 年 11 月 20 日推出的全新子品牌，被官方称为华为双品牌布局的重要一环，与华为主品牌共享技术底座、统一品质标准，定位为面向先锋探索者的鸿蒙 AI 全场景科技品牌，其首款产品即为 OSTA O1 Pro。目前已有 500 余家鸿蒙生态伙伴参与 OSTA 星芒项目。 硬件配置方面，OSTA O1 Pro 搭载麒麟 9030S 芯片与 HarmonyOS 7 AI 先锋版操作系统，配备 6.39 英寸 16:9.5 比例的阔感 OLED 屏幕（2232 × 1320 分辨率、120Hz 刷新率、6500nits 局部峰值亮度），内置 7000mAh 大电池，支持 66W 有线快充与 50W 无线快充。 该机提供星空黑、星云白、星芒紫三款配色，存储版本与官方首发价分别为：12GB+256GB 版 5699 元、12GB+512GB 版 6699 元、16GB+512GB 版 7499 元、16GB+1TB 版 8999 元。 外观方面，OSTA O1 Pro 采用 16:9.5 比例的阔直板形态，正面四边黑边宽度均为 1.05mm，屏占比达到 96.1%，机身厚度 6.68mm，重量控制在约 203g，搭配轻质合金中框。 eSIM 即嵌入式 SIM 卡，是通过远程配置将号码写入手机等终端的通信方案，无需插入实体卡片，具备节省机身空间、可多号存储、便于切换等优势，目前已逐步成为手机、智能穿戴、平板等设备的主流配置方式。 在国内，三大运营商均已推出面向手机的 eSIM 业务：中国联通覆盖苹果、华为、OPPO、荣耀、三星、vivo、联想等品牌的国行 eSIM 机型；中国移动单台手机最多可存储 2 个移动 eSIM 号码；中国电信则主要支持 iPhone、华为 Mate 系列等旗舰机型。手机 eSIM 套餐与实体卡套餐通用，暂无额外溢价。

items.title_zh: 华为 × 澳门电讯联合发布 Wi-Fi 感知服务，支持动态感知并识别家庭成员活动状态
items.title_en: Huawei and CTM jointly launch Wi-Fi sensing service, supporting dynamic sensing and identification of family members' activity status
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，据华为光网今日分享，澳门电讯（CTM）携手华为联合发布“AI-FTTR”宽带服务，并基于华为 FTTR 全光组网解决方案的智能计算能力，融合 AI Wi-Fi 感知及 AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰两大核心技术，推出 Wi-Fi 感知服务商用套餐。 ▲ 图源：华为光网 | 澳门电讯与华为联合创新，发布 Wi-Fi 感知服务 据介绍，传统家庭宽带仅提供连接服务，增值服务空间受限，这已成为全球运营商共同关注的课题。澳门电讯围绕家庭网络体验痛点，发布 AI Wi-Fi 感知与 AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰技术服务，实现从“被动连接”到“主动感知、智能优化”的升级。 AI Wi-Fi 感知服务突破了传统 Wi-Fi 路由器业务的边界，无需额外添加硬件设备， 即可通过 FTTR 终端实时分析 Wi-Fi 信号波动，动态感知并识别家庭成员活动状态 。例如，在用户离家模式下识别到异常走动时，将通过 CTM Wi-Fi 管家 App 向用户推送异常通知，助力家庭安防能力提升。 IT之家从华为官方了解到，AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰技术基于华为 FTTR 终端内置的超 10 万干扰场景模型，可实时分析家庭 Wi-Fi 环境中的各类干扰，如邻居信号串扰、人员走动干扰等，并自动调整 Wi-Fi 的发射参数， 实现在干扰场景下速率提升 20% 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 23: According to Huawei Optical Network's post today, Macau Telecom (CTM) and Huawei jointly launched the “AI-FTTR” broadband service. Based on the intelligent computing capabilities of Huawei's FTTR all-optical networking solution and integrating two core technologies—AI Wi-Fi sensing and AI Wi-Fi anti-interference—they introduced a commercial Wi-Fi sensing service package. (Image source: Huawei Optical Network) According to the introduction, traditional home broadband only provides connectivity, limiting value-added service space, a common issue for global operators. Focusing on home network experience pain points, CTM launched AI Wi-Fi sensing and AI Wi-Fi anti-interference services, upgrading from “passive connectivity” to “active sensing and intelligent optimization.” The AI Wi-Fi sensing service breaks the boundary of traditional Wi-Fi router services: without adding extra hardware, it can analyze Wi-Fi signal fluctuations in real time through the FTTR terminal and dynamically sense and identify family members' activity status. For example, when abnormal walking is detected in away mode, it pushes an abnormal notification to the user via the CTM Wi-Fi Manager App, helping improve home security. IT Home learned from Huawei that the AI Wi-Fi anti-interference technology is based on more than 100,000 interference scenario models built into the Huawei FTTR terminal; it can analyze various interference in the home Wi-Fi environment in real time, such as neighbor signal crosstalk and people walking interference, and automatically adjust Wi-Fi transmission parameters, achieving a 20% rate improvement in interference scenarios.
items.why_zh: 推测该服务把家庭宽带从单纯连接扩展为可感知、可变现的增值服务，但对家庭成员活动识别也带来隐私与合规问题；来源未讨论这些边界。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，据华为光网今日分享，澳门电讯（CTM）携手华为联合发布“AI-FTTR”宽带服务，并基于华为 FTTR 全光组网解决方案的智能计算能力，融合 AI Wi-Fi 感知及 AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰两大核心技术，推出 Wi-Fi 感知服务商用套餐。 ▲ 图源：华为光网 | 澳门电讯与华为联合创新，发布 Wi-Fi 感知服务 据介绍，传统家庭宽带仅提供连接服务，增值服务空间受限，这已成为全球运营商共同关注的课题。澳门电讯围绕家庭网络体验痛点，发布 AI Wi-Fi 感知与 AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰技术服务，实现从“被动连接”到“主动感知、智能优化”的升级。 AI Wi-Fi 感知服务突破了传统 Wi-Fi 路由器业务的边界，无需额外添加硬件设备， 即可通过 FTTR 终端实时分析 Wi-Fi 信号波动，动态感知并识别家庭成员活动状态 。例如，在用户离家模式下识别到异常走动时，将通过 CTM Wi-Fi 管家 App 向用户推送异常通知，助力家庭安防能力提升。 IT之家从华为官方了解到，AI Wi-Fi 抗干扰技术基于华为 FTTR 终端内置的超 10 万干扰场景模型，可实时分析家庭 Wi-Fi 环境中的各类干扰，如邻居信号串扰、人员走动干扰等，并自动调整 Wi-Fi 的发射参数， 实现在干扰场景下速率提升 20% 。

items.title_zh: 李健：荣耀已有多个定位清晰的产品系列，可以在合适时机推出子品牌
items.title_en: Li Jian: Honor already has multiple clearly positioned product series and can launch a sub-brand at the right time
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，荣耀未来会不会推出自己的子品牌？在今日的荣耀新品发布会媒体访谈中，荣耀 CEO 李健给出了回应： 荣耀已有多个定位清晰的产品系列，可以在合适的时候推出自己的子品牌 。 李健进一步表示， 荣耀只是在等待合适的时机 。不过，现场并未公布具体名称、推出时间，也没有透露是否会从现有产品系列中拆分。 据IT之家今日早些时候报道，在谈及华为推出子品牌星芒一事时，李健称，对荣耀不用有任何担心，现在的荣耀不是六年前的荣耀， 荣耀已经走出了自己的道路 。 他直言，越有竞争，越有挑战越兴奋，荣耀期待的是百花齐放，让消费者有更多的选择。此前还有博主询问荣耀关海涛，华为推出子品牌星芒会不会对荣耀有影响？关海涛对此回应称：欢迎星芒，一起荣耀！ 这件事最大的意义，就是让大家知道荣耀是荣耀 。 延伸阅读 华为子品牌 OSTA 星芒于 2026 年 11 月 20 日正式发布，品牌首款鸿蒙 AI 手机 OSTA O1 Pro 同步登场，首发限时优惠价 5499 元起。OSTA 星芒是面向先锋探索者的鸿蒙 AI 全场景科技品牌，秉持“Come as you are，自有光芒”的品牌主张，与华为主品牌共享技术底座、统一品质标准。该机提供星芒紫、星云白、星空黑三款配色，搭载麒麟 9030S 芯片与 HarmonyOS 7 AI 先锋版。 李健口中“六年前的荣耀”，指的是荣耀的独立。2020 年 11 月 17 日，华为投资控股有限公司宣布整体出售荣耀业务资产，收购方为深圳市智信新信息技术有限公司，共有 30 余家荣耀代理商、经销商联合发起了本次收购。交割后的荣耀，华为不占有任何股份，也不参与经营管理与决策。荣耀品牌诞生于 2013 年，独立前始终面向年轻人、坚持中低端价位。 目前荣耀各产品系列的定位有所不同：Magic 系列是综合性能旗舰，数字系列主打影像，GT 系列主打性能与游戏，X 系列主打中端市场，畅玩系列主打入门款普惠科技，此外还有主打长续航的 power 系列。李健表示，上述任意一个系列都可独立做成子品牌。 在战略层面，荣耀于 2025 年 3 月正式发布阿尔法战略，计划五年投入 100 亿美元，分三步向全球领先的 AI 终端生态公司转型：从打造智慧手机、构筑智慧生态，到共建智慧世界。截至 2025 年，荣耀全球研发团队人员占比超过 70%，研发投入占营收比重高达 11.5%，累计获得 AI 相关专利已超过 2100 项。 此次李健作出回应的发布活动为“ 荣耀 700 系列追光之旅暨全场景新品发布会”，除手机外，荣耀手表 Fit 6 等全场景新品也在同期亮相。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 23: At the media interview of Honor's new product launch event today, Honor CEO Li Jian responded to whether Honor will launch its own sub-brand: Honor already has multiple product series with clear positioning and can launch its own sub-brand at an appropriate time; it is only waiting for the right timing. No specific name, launch time, or whether it would be split off from existing product series was announced on site. When discussing Huawei's launch of the sub-brand Starlight, Li Jian said there is no need to worry about Honor—today's Honor is not the Honor of six years ago and has walked its own path. He said he is more excited by more competition and challenges, and Honor looks forward to many brands blooming so consumers have more choices. Guan Haitao previously responded to a blogger's question about whether Huawei's sub-brand Starlight would affect Honor by saying, “Welcome Starlight, together Honor!” In background, Huawei's sub-brand OSTA Starlight was officially released on Nov. 20, 2026, with its first HarmonyOS AI phone, OSTA O1 Pro, debuting at a limited-time launch price starting at 5,499 yuan; it is a HarmonyOS AI full-scenario technology brand for pioneer explorers, sharing Huawei's technology base and unified quality standards, offering Starlight Purple, Nebula White, and Starry Black colors, and equipped with the Kirin 9030S chip and HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition. Li Jian's reference to “Honor six years ago” points to Honor's independence: on Nov. 17, 2020, Huawei Investment & Holding announced the overall sale of Honor's business assets to Shenzhen Zhixin New Information Technology, with more than 30 Honor agents and distributors jointly initiating the acquisition; after the transaction, Huawei holds no shares and does not participate in management or decision-making. The Honor brand was born in 2013 and before independence always targeted young people and adhered to mid- and low-end price points. Currently Honor's product series have different positions: Magic is the comprehensive performance flagship, the number series focuses on imaging, GT focuses on performance and gaming, X focuses on the mid-range market, Play focuses on entry-level inclusive technology, and there is also the power series focused on long battery life. Li Jian said any of these series could independently become a sub-brand. Strategically, Honor officially released the Alpha strategy in March 2025, planning to invest $10 billion over five years and transform in three steps into a globally leading AI terminal ecosystem company: from building smart phones and a smart ecosystem to co-building a smart world. As of 2025, Honor's global R&D team accounts for more than 70% of staff, R&D investment accounts for 11.5% of revenue, and cumulative AI-related patents exceed 2,100. The launch event where Li Jian made the response was the “Honor 700 Series Journey to Light and Full-Scenario New Product Launch”; besides phones, full-scenario products such as Honor Watch Fit 6 also appeared.
items.why_zh: 推测此举表明荣耀在应对华为子品牌竞争时保留品牌分层选项，但具体计划尚未公布。
items.why_en: Speculatively, this suggests Honor is keeping brand-tiering options open in responding to competition from Huawei's sub-brand, but specific plans have not been announced.

items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 23 that Voyah officially announced yesterday that the 2027 Voyah Taishan will open pre-sales on Nov 27. Today Voyah released a teaser video. The new car's exterior continues the previous generation, with a 'Tiandi Kunpeng' front design and 588 'dragon-scale patterns'; it is equipped with Huawei Qiankun 896-line lidar, the Huju chassis, and the Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving system. The new Taishan adopts a large six-seat layout and switches the front row to a new dual-screen design (possibly the same Huawei dual 15.6-inch smart dual-screen first used on Taishan X8). Voyah has not announced more configuration details. For reference, the current Voyah Taishan launched on Nov 18 last year in four versions priced at 379,900–509,900 yuan; main features include China-first three-chamber air suspension (110mm adjustment travel, 100 times/sec road preview smart damping adjustment, 4 stiffness levels, 5 height levels), Huawei Qiankun ADS 4 four-lidar solution, distributed 4D mmWave radar, HarmonySpace 5 cockpit (first with AI voice large model, MoLA architecture, five Agent intelligent agents), AI Yunshu seats (66 high-precision sensors, 22-way electric zero-gravity adjustment, 26-point massage, 12-layer cloud-sensing technology), flexible 6/5/4-seat switching, HUAWEI XPIXEL smart projection headlights, Kunpeng wing pedals and light carpet, dual-shield reinforced doors (2200MPa hot-formed bumper beam, 30% improved side-impact protection), 800V high-voltage platform + 5C ultra-fast charging (65kWh battery, CLTC pure-electric range 350km, CLTC combined range 1400km+), plus exterior colors Liujin Purple, Xuanmo Gold, Chixia Purple, Yuanshan Blue, Xuanying Black, Chenxing Gray, Champagne Gold, Duruo White and interior colors Xuan Red, Warm Brown, Yunmi.

items.summary_en: IT之家 Nov 23: after today's Honor 700 series event and all-scenario launch event, Honor CEO Li Jian, Honor product line president Fang Fei, and Honor brand marketing president and global CMO Guan Haitao spoke with media. Li announced that Honor's wide-folding phone is planned to debut in March 2027 and said the device has 'no crease at all.' He also said Honor leads the industry in foldable craftsmanship, battery life and AI capabilities, and will continue related innovation. Fang said the real wide-folding device already exists. IT之家 previously reported that tipster @数码闲聊站 said in September that Honor also has a wide-folding phone, with a 2nm Snapdragon new chip, scheduled for 2027Q1, hoping to launch before Spring Festival. According to the tipster, Honor's wide fold uses a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6 series processor, with the main screen tested at about 7.6 inches and the cover screen at about 5.5 inches.

items.title_zh: 小鹏图灵世界模型 X-World 完成重要升级，推出构建虚拟城市能力等
items.title_en: XPeng Turing world model X-World completes major upgrade, adds virtual city construction
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，小鹏汽车官方今日宣布，近日，X-World 基于小鹏第二代 VLA 研发现实需求，迎来首次重要升级。新一代 X-World 1.6 包含两大重要升级： 其一， 推出构建虚拟城市（Virtual City）的能力 ：让环境仿真深植现实场景，提升环境复现与环境增强能力。模型可在云端构建具备空间与时间记忆的「城市数字分身」，支持回到现实场景任意时空点重跑验证； 其二， 大幅提升推理实时性 ：X-World 实现交互仿真实时化，解决推理效率成本瓶颈，为大规模应用扫平障碍。同时，研发测试人员也可通过方向盘踏板直接驶入模型生成的世界，实时体验 / 评估生成世界。 小鹏汽车表示，上一代 X-World 1.0 属于纯生成式的技术路线，无中生有建立世界。这种思路 fanciness 有余而实用不足。在应用中遇到了很多实际挑战：北京四环桥下路口来回走两趟，桥墩位置出现变化；同一场景只想改变天气，结果红绿灯位置和变绿时机也出现了变化；某城中村窄道通行场景刁钻，靠无中生有很难生成类似场景，而在真实数据上做增强却能制造各种 case..... 研发中的实际痛点和需求都指向一点： 真实智驾模型研发中，世界仿真器不只能无中生有，更要具备基于真实世界的场景复现及场景增强能力。 此次升级，X-World 完成结构重建与动态生成的结合：以 3D 高斯、点云或其他时刻走过这段路的视频 / 图片提供静态受控能力，锚定建筑、道路等静态场景元素；由 DiT 生成模型负责动态物体、轨迹、天气光照等可变内容。 在此基础上，研发团队构建了「虚拟城市」—— 通过用户回传的视频在云端持续复现城市记忆，静态受控范围同时覆盖空间与时间两个维度。举个例子，某路段的占道施工持续了半年，虚拟城市可以分别回到施工前、中、后的任意时间点，调用智驾模型在同一地点、同一时刻重跑验证；上一版模型当时处理不好的场景，新版模型可以回去重跑一遍；On-policy RL 在某一时空点同时 rollout 多次，场景一致因此行为可比；现实世界的每个瞬间只发生一次，而 Virtual City 可以在同一时空点上生成平行时空的新故事线。 与行业内以静态场景重建见长的「子弹时间」式路线不同，X-World 1.6 强调的正是这种平行时空能力。随着城市记忆的持续积累，生成轨迹与真实轨迹的差值越来越小，场景复现精度持续提升。 ▲ 静态场景的绝对受控，相比现行 X-World 具备更好的场景级复现能力 ▲ 基于任意一张「街景图片」，可以生成七路摄像头信息，完成动态场景预测 本次升级的另一个方向，是实时推理优化。X-World 规模性应用落地，需要算推理成本这笔账。On-policy RL 多路 rollout 对环境模型推理 latency 十分敏感，推理性能极易影响训练效率。闭环评测与数据生产，推理吞吐低同样将令应用成本居高不下。 因此，推理效率优化成为 X-World 规模应用的必由之路。小鹏的思路是让推理优化这项研发工作在团队内变得有趣：工程师代替智驾模型在 X-World 中上手开车，发挥聪明才智降低操控延迟，提升游戏体验。转动方向盘、踩下踏板，这套 Harness 不光用以提升效率，也可作为世界模型质检工具交付人类测试员。 为此，团队从 kernel 调度、多卡并行、算子融合到编解码全链路进行了系统性推理优化，在保持高帧率输出的同时，操控延迟也缩短至 426 ms，其综合推理性能达到同类模型的业界最先进水平，相关技术细节已通过技术博客完整公开。X-World 的本次升级解决了自动驾驶仿真落地中的三个核心问题。 第一，提高仿真测试的可信度与可复现性。 过往的闭环仿真中，同一场景无法重现，版本迭代的效果难以严格对比；虚拟城市的时空回溯特性让“同题重考”成为可能，为大规模闭环评估和在线强化学习提供了稳定基准。虚拟城市的概念起源于小鹏 Robotaxi 的研发讨论。智驾模型可以在云端虚拟 Robotaxi ODD 区域内完成各种维度的场景增强，保证云端的充分测试。 第二，低成本规模落地。 智驾模型可在虚拟城市中低成本仿真，便于大规模应用于训练 / 测试 / 数据生产。同时，利用 X-World 也可以在海外的一些数据紧缺的地方补充数据生产。 第三，主动测试长尾场景。 闭环仿真中由智驾模型…
items.summary_en: IT之家 Nov 23: XPeng announced today that X-World has received its first major upgrade based on real development needs of XPeng's second-generation VLA. X-World 1.6 includes two major upgrades. First, it adds the ability to build a Virtual City, rooting environment simulation in real scenes and improving environment reproduction and enhancement; the model can build a 'city digital twin' with spatial and temporal memory in the cloud and support rerunning validation at any time-space point in a real scene. Second, it greatly improves real-time inference, enabling real-time interactive simulation and addressing inference efficiency and cost bottlenecks; R&D testers can drive directly into the model-generated world via steering wheel and pedals for real-time experience/evaluation. XPeng says the previous X-World 1.0 was a pure generative route that created worlds from nothing, and in practice faced challenges such as bridge pier positions changing, traffic light positions and green-light timing changing when only weather was meant to change, and difficulty generating similar scenes for tricky urban-village narrow roads; therefore a world simulator must not only create from nothing but also reproduce and enhance scenes based on the real world. This upgrade combines structural reconstruction and dynamic generation: 3D Gaussian, point clouds or video/images from other times provide static controlled capability to anchor buildings, roads and other static elements; a DiT generative model handles dynamic objects, trajectories, weather and lighting and other variable content. The Virtual City continuously reproduces city memory in the cloud from user-uploaded videos, with static control covering both space and time. For example, if road occupation construction at a section lasted six months, it can return to any time point before, during or after construction and call the driving model to rerun validation at the same place and time; On-policy RL can roll out multiple times at one time-space point, and consistent scenes make behaviors comparable; each moment in the real world happens only once, while Virtual City can generate new parallel-timeline storylines at the same time-space point. Unlike the industry's 'bullet time' route known for static scene reconstruction, X-World 1.6 emphasizes this parallel-timeline capability; as city memory accumulates, the difference between generated and real trajectories becomes smaller, and scene reproduction accuracy continues to improve. Based on any one 'street view image,' it can generate seven camera views and complete dynamic scene prediction. On inference optimization, XPeng says scaled application requires accounting for inference cost: On-policy RL multi-route rollout is sensitive to inference latency, and closed-loop evaluation and data production are also affected by throughput; the team lets engineers drive in X-World instead of the driving model to reduce control latency, and this Harness can also serve as a world-model quality-check tool delivered to human testers. The team systematically optimized the full chain from kernel scheduling, multi-GPU parallelism, operator fusion to codec, maintaining high frame-rate output while shortening control latency to 426 ms; comprehensive inference performance reaches the industry's most advanced level among similar models, and technical details have been published via a technical blog. This X-World upgrade addresses three core issues: improving the credibility and reproducibility of simulation testing—virtual city time-space backtracking makes 'retaking the same test' possible, providing a stable benchmark for large-scale closed-loop evaluation and online reinforcement learning, with the virtual city concept originating from XPeng Robotaxi R&D discussions; low-cost scaled deployment—facilitating large-scale use in training/testing/data production and supplementing data production in overseas data-scarce areas; actively testing long-tail scenarios (summary truncated here).

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，小鹏汽车官方今日宣布，近日，X-World 基于小鹏第二代 VLA 研发现实需求，迎来首次重要升级。新一代 X-World 1.6 包含两大重要升级： 其一， 推出构建虚拟城市（Virtual City）的能力 ：让环境仿真深植现实场景，提升环境复现与环境增强能力。模型可在云端构建具备空间与时间记忆的「城市数字分身」，支持回到现实场景任意时空点重跑验证； 其二， 大幅提升推理实时性 ：X-World 实现交互仿真实时化，解决推理效率成本瓶颈，为大规模应用扫平障碍。同时，研发测试人员也可通过方向盘踏板直接驶入模型生成的世界，实时体验 / 评估生成世界。 小鹏汽车表示，上一代 X-World 1.0 属于纯生成式的技术路线，无中生有建立世界。这种思路 fanciness 有余而实用不足。在应用中遇到了很多实际挑战：北京四环桥下路口来回走两趟，桥墩位置出现变化；同一场景只想改变天气，结果红绿灯位置和变绿时机也出现了变化；某城中村窄道通行场景刁钻，靠无中生有很难生成类似场景，而在真实数据上做增强却能制造各种 case..... 研发中的实际痛点和需求都指向一点： 真实智驾模型研发中，世界仿真器不只能无中生有，更要具备基于真实世界的场景复现及场景增强能力。 此次升级，X-World 完成结构重建与动态生成的结合：以 3D 高斯、点云或其他时刻走过这段路的视频 / 图片提供静态受控能力，锚定建筑、道路等静态场景元素；由 DiT 生成模型负责动态物体、轨迹、天气光照等可变内容。 在此基础上，研发团队构建了「虚拟城市」—— 通过用户回传的视频在云端持续复现城市记忆，静态受控范围同时覆盖空间与时间两个维度。举个例子，某路段的占道施工持续了半年，虚拟城市可以分别回到施工前、中、后的任意时间点，调用智驾模型在同一地点、同一时刻重跑验证；上一版模型当时处理不好的场景，新版模型可以回去重跑一遍；On-policy RL 在某一时空点同时 rollout 多次，场景一致因此行为可比；现实世界的每个瞬间只发生一次，而 Virtual City 可以在同一时空点上生成平行时空的新故事线。 与行业内以静态场景重建见长的「子弹时间」式路线不同，X-World 1.6 强调的正是这种平行时空能力。随着城市记忆的持续积累，生成轨迹与真实轨迹的差值越来越小，场景复现精度持续提升。 ▲ 静态场景的绝对受控，相比现行 X-World 具备更好的场景级复现能力 ▲ 基于任意一张「街景图片」，可以生成七路摄像头信息，完成动态场景预测 本次升级的另一个方向，是实时推理优化。X-World 规模性应用落地，需要算推理成本这笔账。On-policy RL 多路 rollout 对环境模型推理 latency 十分敏感，推理性能极易影响训练效率。闭环评测与数据生产，推理吞吐低同样将令应用成本居高不下。 因此，推理效率优化成为 X-World 规模应用的必由之路。小鹏的思路是让推理优化这项研发工作在团队内变得有趣：工程师代替智驾模型在 X-World 中上手开车，发挥聪明才智降低操控延迟，提升游戏体验。转动方向盘、踩下踏板，这套 Harness 不光用以提升效率，也可作为世界模型质检工具交付人类测试员。 为此，团队从 kernel 调度、多卡并行、算子融合到编解码全链路进行了系统性推理优化，在保持高帧率输出的同时，操控延迟也缩短至 426 ms，其综合推理性能达到同类模型的业界最先进水平，相关技术细节已通过技术博客完整公开。X-World 的本次升级解决了自动驾驶仿真落地中的三个核心问题。 第一，提高仿真测试的可信度与可复现性。 过往的闭环仿真中，同一场景无法重现，版本迭代的效果难以严格对比；虚拟城市的时空回溯特性让“同题重考”成为可能，为大规模闭环评估和在线强化学习提供了稳定基准。虚拟城市的概念起源于小鹏 Robotaxi 的研发讨论。智驾模型可以在云端虚拟 Robotaxi ODD 区域内完成各种维度的场景增强，保证云端的充分测试。 第二，低成本规模落地。 智驾模型可在虚拟城市中低成本仿真，便于大规模应用于训练 / 测试 / 数据生产。同时，利用 X-World 也可以在海外的一些数据紧缺的地方补充数据生产。 第三，主动测试长尾场景。 闭环仿真中由智驾模型…

items.title_zh: Meta 在美国一小镇建造其全球最大数据中心，居民生活剧变
items.title_en: Meta builds its largest global data center in a small US town, upending residents' lives
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，据 BusinessInsider 报道，多年来，苏珊 · 李（Susan Lee）最喜欢做的事情之一，就是站在路易斯安那州自家院子里，拍摄夕阳缓缓落在附近田野上的美景。 如今，那片田野已经变成了一座规模庞大的建筑工地。 “我们的日落美景已经没了。”她 42 岁的女儿里基 · 古德温（Rikki Goodwin）在今年 9 月接受采访时说，“现在映入眼帘的是两个漂亮的水箱、一栋橙色建筑、一栋灰色建筑，还有几根高大的柱子。” 李和古德温是当地居民中的一员。他们正在适应一位新邻居的到来：Meta。 这家科技巨头正在路易斯安那州霍利里奇（Holly Ridge）附近建设其有史以来规模最大的人工智能数据中心。霍利里奇是一个位于里奇兰教区（Richland Parish）的小型非建制社区。整个项目占地近 1,000 万平方英尺 （IT之家注：约 92.9 万平方米） ，约合 229 英亩。 这个规模有多大？作为对比，华特迪士尼世界的魔法王国主题乐园占地约 142 英亩，而梵蒂冈城国的面积约为 108 英亩。 “到了晚上，那里看起来就像一座城市。”75 岁的里奇兰教区居民巴迪 · 麦卡特尼（Buddy McCartney）说。 由于谷歌地图上的卫星图像比较模糊，而且拍摄时间较早，很难直观感受到这座数据中心的真实规模。为此，记者专程前往里奇兰教区，实地查看这项庞大的建设工程，并采访当地居民，了解生活在一家市值万亿美元的科技巨头项目旁边究竟是什么感受。 对于一些居民来说，Meta 的到来创造了新的经济机会，催生了不少创业项目和本地生意。对于另一些人而言，施工噪声、交通拥堵和扬尘等问题，则让他们不得不面对发展带来的阵痛。 Meta 一名发言人表示，公司“非常重视”周边居民的担忧。 这名发言人称：“我们正在投入超过 2.7 亿美元 （现汇率约合 18.04 亿元人民币） 改善当地道路，并已在项目附近安装新的交通信号灯。承包商必须严格遵守交通安全规定，同时采取抑尘措施，尽可能减少施工对周边环境的影响。我们每周都会与社区合作伙伴和承包商召开会议，并与当地政府部门合作解决居民提出的问题。” 数据中心带火当地生意 记者和同事沿着 183 号公路寻找数据中心时，当地气温已经接近华氏 99 度，约合摄氏 37 摄氏度。 最初几英里的景象可以说相当平淡：一所小学、一家 Dollar General 折扣零售店、几栋分散在大片土地上的住宅，以及一些树木。 然而，在灼热的阳光下，数据中心的建设现场逐渐映入眼帘。原本种满农作物的田地，如今已经被一排排橙色路障、挖掘机、新建建筑以及大量身穿高可视度反光背心的施工人员取代。 记者一行驱车近 3 英里后，才在这片庞大园区的一个入口处停车，但施工现场仍向远处延伸了至少 1 英里。 在自卸卡车和施工车辆不断穿梭的工地旁，记者走访了霍利里奇当地的 HeBrews Coffee & Eats 咖啡餐饮店。这是受益于数据中心建设的多家本地商户之一。 自 Meta 于 2024 年正式动工以来，一些当地居民开始抓住这一机会，希望从大型工程带来的需求中赚取收入。这家餐饮店的餐车就停在一个施工入口对面，方便工人随时购买食物和饮料。 TJ· 威德（TJ Weed）和凯西 · 威德（Kaycie Weed）夫妇五年前就在附近的雷维尔（Rayville）开设了 HeBrews Coffee & Eats 咖啡馆。不过，位于霍利里奇的新店直到 2025 年才开业，主要就是为了服务 Meta 数据中心项目。 TJ 表示：“霍利里奇店承接了大部分餐饮配送业务。如果是 Meta 旗下相关企业的订单，我都会安排霍利里奇店负责。” 霍利里奇门店负责人谢尔比 · 史蒂芬森（Shelbie Stephenson）介绍，他们每月会向 Meta 施工现场配送两次午餐，每次约 450 份。此外，每个月还会承接数次咖啡和早餐配送业务。 “在安全周活动期间，我们曾经一次性提供了 900 个墨西哥卷饼和 2500 杯咖啡。”她说。 另一家因数据中心项目而兴起的企业是 Ice Queen，由大卫 · 罗杰斯（David Rodgers）联合创立。这家企业同样于 2025 年开始营业，最初主要向 Meta 项目的分包商和施工企业出售冰块，每袋售价 3…
items.summary_en: IT之家 Nov 23: BusinessInsider reported that for years, one of Susan Lee's favorite things was standing in her Louisiana yard and photographing sunsets over nearby fields. Now that field has become a huge construction site. 'Our sunset view is gone,' her 42-year-old daughter Rikki Goodwin said in an interview in September. 'Now what meets the eye are two nice water tanks, an orange building, a gray building, and several tall columns.' Lee and Goodwin are among local residents adapting to a new neighbor: Meta. The tech giant is building its largest-ever AI data center near Holly Ridge, a small unincorporated community in Richland Parish, Louisiana. The project covers nearly 10 million square feet (about 929,000 sq m), about 229 acres. For comparison, Walt Disney World's Magic Kingdom covers about 142 acres, and Vatican City is about 108 acres. 'At night, it looks like a city,' said 75-year-old Richland Parish resident Buddy McCartney. Because Google Maps satellite images are blurry and old, the reporter traveled to Richland Parish to see the construction project and interview residents about what it is like to live next to a trillion-dollar tech giant's project. For some residents, Meta's arrival has created new economic opportunities and spawned startups and local businesses; for others, construction noise, traffic congestion and dust bring pain from development. A Meta spokesperson said the company 'takes seriously' nearby residents' concerns and is investing more than $270 million (about 1.804 billion yuan at current exchange rates) to improve local roads, and has installed new traffic lights near the project; contractors must strictly follow traffic safety rules and take dust suppression measures; the company meets weekly with community partners and contractors and works with local government departments to address residents' issues. While driving along Highway 183 to find the data center, the reporter found the temperature near 99°F (about 37°C); the first few miles included an elementary school, a Dollar General discount store, several scattered homes and trees, then the data center construction site gradually appeared, with farmland replaced by rows of orange barriers, excavators, new buildings and many construction workers in high-visibility vests. The reporter drove nearly 3 miles to park at one entrance, but the construction site still extended at least 1 mile into the distance. Next to trucks and construction vehicles, the reporter visited local HeBrews Coffee & Eats in Holly Ridge, one of several local businesses benefiting from the data center construction. Since Meta formally broke ground in 2024, some local residents have begun seizing the opportunity to earn income; the food truck is parked across from a construction entrance. TJ and Kaycie Weed opened HeBrews in nearby Rayville five years ago, but the new Holly Ridge store did not open until 2025, mainly to serve the Meta data center project. TJ said the Holly Ridge store handles most catering delivery business, and Meta-related orders are assigned there. Holly Ridge store manager Shelbie Stephenson said they deliver lunch to the Meta construction site twice a month, about 450 meals each time, and also handle several coffee and breakfast deliveries each month; 'during Safety Week, we once provided 900 burritos and 2,500 cups of coffee.' Another business that arose from the data center project is Ice Queen, co-founded by David Rodgers; it also began operating in 2025, initially mainly selling ice to Meta project subcontractors and construction firms at $3 per bag... items.title_en: Meta Muse can do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
items.summary_zh: Muse 可以帮你寻找沃尔玛的黑五优惠。沃尔玛将允许 Meta 的 Muse 代为购物，让该 AI 代理通过沃尔玛的 Sparky AI 助手查找并购买黑五优惠商品。据沃尔玛称，这家零售巨头正在上线其上月宣布的 Agent Gateway 的实时实现，该网关可帮助 AI 代理为你找到相关商品，而无需共享你的购买历史。Muse 可通过沃尔玛的“Agent Profiles”进行购买；这些档案在用户的沃尔玛账户内为代理活动提供专门空间，还允许设置支出限额、批准购买，并查看 Muse 购买的所有商品历史……完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Muse can find Walmart’s Black Friday deals so that you don’t have to. | Image: Walmart Walmart will now let Meta's Muse shop on your behalf, allowing the AI agent to find and purchase Black Friday deals via Walmart's Sparky AI assistant. The retail giant is rolling out a live implementation of the Agent Gateway it announced last month , which helps AI agents find relevant products for you without sharing your purchase history, according to Walmart. items.title_en: 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference Set for Nov 26 at Guangzhou International Auto Show
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，华为乾崑 App 显示， 2026 华为乾崑生态大会将于 11 月 26 日在广州车展举行 。 据华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志此前预热， 华为与生态伙伴打造的“十分钟华为乾崑智驾生活圈”将在本届华为乾崑生态大会上亮相 。 今年 9 月，华为智能汽车解决方案 BU 官方微博宣布，乾崑智驾和鸿蒙座舱搭载量、华为乾崑 App 用户数 200 万里程碑同步达成。 据IT之家此前报道，在今年 7 月的 2026 华为乾崑媒体日上，华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志透露，从 2023 年到 2026 年，华为乾崑智驾的算力增长超过 20 倍。靳玉志认为，要做好自动驾驶，算力是非常重要的。他表示，未来 5 年，华为乾崑在算力研发上将持续投入，达到 700 到 800 亿元。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 23: The Huawei Qiankun app shows that the 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference will be held on Nov 26 at the Guangzhou auto show. According to earlier teasers from Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei's Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, the "10-minute Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving life circle" built with ecosystem partners will be unveiled at the conference. In September this year, the official Weibo account of Huawei's Intelligent Automotive Solution BU announced that the 2 million milestone was reached simultaneously for Qiankun intelligent driving and HarmonyOS cockpit installations and for Huawei Qiankun app users. IT Home previously reported that at the 2026 Huawei Qiankun Media Day in July, Jin Yuzhi said Huawei Qiankun's intelligent driving computing power grew more than 20-fold from 2023 to 2026. Jin said computing power is very important for good autonomous driving, and that over the next five years Huawei Qiankun will keep investing in computing power R&D, reaching 70-80 billion yuan.
items.why_zh: （推测）该大会可能展示华为智能驾驶与座舱生态的最新进展，其此前公布的数百亿元算力投入规模值得关注。
items.why_en: (Speculation) The conference may showcase the latest progress in Huawei's intelligent driving and cockpit ecosystem, and the scale of its previously announced multi-billion-yuan computing power investment is worth watching.
